topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Sir, I owe you an account of the swarm of bees that visited our fields last week. It was a sight, I tell you, buzzing and dancing over the crops. But that's not what I truly wanted to speak of. I've been turning over a thought in my mind, like a stone underfoot. You see, I found an old book of yours, left in my cottage. It was wrapped in a sheepskin, and I reckon it must have come to me with a bale of wool last trade day. The book, it's filled with tales and numbers, and I think it would serve you better than me. If you're willing, I could bring it to the market next time, wrapped safe and sound.
